summary: Lower prefix -- through a reference-aware helper that performs JS numeric coercion and writes once.

target.notes: Evaluate the reference once, GetValue once, ToNumeric, apply +1/-1 in the same numeric kind, SetValue once, then return the new value.

caveats: Property references can invoke getters/setters; preserve their order.
Invalid assignment targets are syntax errors before lowering.

tests.name: edge prefix decrement property accessor order
tests.input: let n=2; const o={get x(){console.log('get');return n},set x(v){console.log('set');n=v}}; console.log(--o.x);
